questions.question: Which instruction is used to store data from a register to a SRAM / location pointed by an address register? Explain.
questions.solution_html:
• Which instruction is used to store data from a register to a SRAM
  • location pointed by an address register? Explain.
  • The instruction used to store data from a register to an SRAM location
  • pointed by an address register in AVR microcontrollers is the ST (Store
  • Indirect) instruction.
  • ST:Stores data from a general-purpose register into the data memory
  • location pointed to by the X, Y, or Z register pair. For example
  • ST Y+, R21 stores the value of register R21 into the memory location
  • pointed to by the Y register pair and then increments the Y register.
questions.final_answer: pointed to by the Y register pair and then increments the Y register

questions.solution_html:
• AVR C program, with a suitable example
  • Ease of Programming
  • C is easier to learn and use than assembly language, while still
  • providing the necessary control over hardware.
  • Easy to modify and update
  • Low-Level Access
  • C allows direct manipulation of hardware registers and peripherals
  • which is essential for embedded systems programming.
  • Portability
  • Code written in C can be easily ported to different AVR devices and
  • even other microcontroller families, with minimal modifications.
  • Efficiency
  • C compilers can generate efficient machine code for AVRs, enabling
  • fast execution and optimal resource utilization.
  • Community Support
  • AVR microcontrollers have a large and active community, providing
  • ample resources, libraries, and support for C programming.
  • Wide Range of Applications
  • AVR microcontrollers are used in diverse applications, including IoT
  • devices, home automation, robotics, and industrial automation, all of
  • which often rely on Embedded C for their functionality.
